deadline_rationale: First 32-step multiple at or above the P5 median R1-to-perception-q25 gap of 91 steps; chosen without navigation outcomes.
candidate_rationale: Finite detector-resolution anchors: 4, 8, or 12 horizontal pixels at 160x120; corresponding absolute area/proximity and relative-area innovations. This is a bounded signal-only calibration, not a navigation-outcome sweep.
selection_rule: Choose the first listed candidate passing all signal-only gates. Navigation outcomes, clearance, contact, collision, and task success are forbidden inputs.
